_doc: Virtual actuator dyno + fatigue for the cloth-feed gripper; script analysis/gripper/dyno.py. Tags: S sourced, D derived, A assumed.

input_file_sha256_16.note: sha256 (first 16 hex) of every input file at run start; dyno.py --check compares with disk

V_rail.note: torque_and_actuator.md 3.6: DS3218MG on a 6.8 V rail (reversible)

T_stall_Nm.note: DS3218MG 21.5 kg*cm @ 6.8 V (Miuzei + SpeedyFPV, actuators.csv A17)

I_stall_datasheet_A.note: Miuzei datasheet 2.2 A @ 6.8 V; Annimos says 1.8 A

eta_gearbox.note: multi-stage metal spur servo gearbox efficiency

gear_ratio.note: DS3218 ratio not published; DS3235 datasheet gives 373 [S]

J_rotor_kgm2.note: 130-size DC motor rotor ~0.6 g*cm^2; +20 % for gear train

deadband_deg.note: 3 us deadband (A17) x 0.09 deg/us (2000 us / 180 deg) [D]

servo_P_saturation_deg.note: position error at which the servo drive reaches full duty

value.pwm_average_value: motor current is the PWM average with continuous, ripple-free conduction (L/R >> PWM period); L ignored. Bounding case i2_bound = |d| ((sgn(d) V - K w)/R)^2 (fully discontinuous) is carried through the thermal run as test3_duty_cycle.thermal_30min_pwm_bound; M6/M7 scope the motor current
value.reflected_rotor_inertia: J_m N^2 is lumped on the output shaft, downstream of the gearbox efficiency, so rotor kinetic energy reaches the teeth with no gearbox loss: jam and collision peaks are conservative
value.knuckle_notch: Kf 1.14 applied on top of the finger_beam Kt 1.5: notch counted twice, conservative

model_assumptions.note: modelling assumptions that bias results; reversible

eta_mesh_pivot.note: DESIGN-BASIS eta 0.85 (applied on each finger path)

k_finger_N_per_m.note: fea_summary.json recommended L45 finger, tip pad, E 67 (linear) = 1.101 N/mm

k_cloth_N_per_m.note: 0.3 mm cotton ply under the pad, through-thickness, stiff spring

gap_at_theta0_m.note: DESIGN-BASIS R18: pads 1 mm apart at theta = 0

x_f_m.note: pad x offset from pivot = a_w/2 - gap/2 (gears.json printed pick m1.5z19a25b8, a_w 28.50)

k_mesh_Nm_per_rad.note: VDI 2736 deformation relation, PA6-CF pair, m1.5z19a25b8

backlash_jt_m.note: jt 0.25 mm design backlash (gears.json recommendation.printed.backlash, tolerance_stacks.md T07)

J_fingerB_kgm2.note: TPU finger 3.64 g at 47.5 mm + 3 g knuckle + 1 g sector

J_shaftA_kgm2.note: reflected rotor (J_m N^2 x 1.2) + finger A + horn

thermal.note: structure and alpha_Cu from maxon 'DC motor and EC motor Key information' (Rth1 winding-housing, Rth2 housing-ambient, winding/motor time constants); values assumed for a small motor inside a plastic servo case; M7 measures

theta_c0.note: CALIBRATE emulation (R21): command angle at FSR >= F_TOUCH with no cloth; geometric pad touch = -asin(G0/(2 r_c)); both negative because theta is + open

collision_intrusion_m.note: arm keeps moving 10 mm before its own stop/stall

arm_effective_mass_kg.note: SO-101 forearm + wrist + gripper effective mass at the TCP

arm_push_force_N.note: STS3215 ~1.9 N*m stall (so101.md) over ~0.1 m wrist lever: force the arm can keep pushing

arm_force_ramp_s.note: arm position loop builds its push force over ~50 ms after contact

Kf_coupon_to_notch.note: printed PLA notch factor 1.12-1.16 (gears.md 2.1); applied to the coupon curves at the knuckle arm root. The finger_beam stress already includes Kt 1.5, so the notch is counted twice: conservative [A]

TPU_printed_knockdown.note: printed weld lines / porosity vs moulded; 0.27 = Z/XY break ratio (6.4/23.7, Ultimaker TDS) as the pessimistic case

value.gear: gears.stresses() per option and material (gear lane)

stress_transfer.note: TPU from fea_summary.json recommended tip (max vM at a sharp rib corner = singular, and p99); knuckle arm top from finger_beam.json design_L45 LC1 tip incl. Kt 1.5 [A]

cap_LC2.note: DESIGN-BASIS LC2 <= 1e3 events; gear-lane LC2 torque incl. K_A 1.25

stall_LC3.note: gears.json n_LC3; quasi-static jam (20 deg/s search) = full stall through the mesh

jam_120dps.note: gears.json n_shock; finger B jams during the 120 deg/s pre-close

rare_events.note: event counts over the 1e5-grip life (A); each is one 0 -> peak cycle; loads D from the shock sims. F_N for stall/jam assumes finger B is blocked at its tip pad (A)

rail_sensitivity_stall_current.note: actuators.csv A17 conflict note: both currents are at 6.8 V; no 5 V stall current is published, so no interpolation

V_rail_sensitivity_6p35V.note: torque_and_actuator.md: 6.5 +- 0.15 V adjustable buck (low end, hold check)

consistency_check.note: An ideal DC motor with eta <= 1 needs T_stall*w0 <= eta*V*I_stall*(1 - I_nl*R/V). The datasheet triple violates it, so one of the three numbers is optimistic [D]. Fit A (baseline) keeps the two mechanical specs and infers the stall current; Fit B keeps the current and infers a slower no-load speed.

test3_duty_cycle.per_cycle_30min_note: Each row is one cycle of the 30-min thermal run: the cycle-1 current profile repeated with R(T) coupled into the copper loss. Peak current, servo and mesh torque are not recomputed per cycle (they are cycle-1 values, see test3_duty_cycle.<fit> and back_to_back_cycles_A_mech for time-domain cycles 1-3 and hot).

120dps_J_low_x0.35.note: T_mesh_peak_Nm = max over the jam-angle x zeta sweep (jam_sweep)

120dps_J_base.note: T_mesh_peak_Nm = max over the jam-angle x zeta sweep (jam_sweep)

120dps_J_high_x2.6.note: T_mesh_peak_Nm = max over the jam-angle x zeta sweep (jam_sweep)
